shortDescription: By Yantoultra NguiChina Shenhua Energy SSE:601088, a Chinese coal producer, said on Friday it raised HK$6.74 billion ($860 million) in a Hong Kong share sale, mainly to repay debt in mainland China.($1 = 7.8364 Hong Kong dollars)

children: , a Chinese coal producer, said on Friday it raised HK$6.74 billion ($860 million) in a Hong Kong share sale, mainly to repay debt in mainland China.
Reuters reported on Thursday, citing a term sheet, that China Shenhua
, which is also listed on the Shanghai stock exchange, was seeking to raise up to $881 million by selling 177 million shares at HK$38.00 to HK$39.00 each
China Shenhua said in a filing that it would sell up to 177 million new Hong Kong shares at HK$38.10 each. The final price was 7.7% below the stock's HK$41.28 close on Thursday
China Shenhua plans to use about 90% of the proceeds to repay debts in mainland China and improve its funding structure. It plans to use the remaining 10% for general corporate purposes
The new shares represent about 0.82% of the company's existing outstanding shares, or 0.81% after the sale
Shares of China Shenhua dropped 6.5% to HK$38.58 on Friday, while its Shanghai shares declined 5.2%
